SELECT DISTINCT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    a.CITY AS city,
    a.STATE AS state,
    a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY od
    ON od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
    ON mdh.DLC_KEY = od.DLC_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
    ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND mdh.DLC_NAME LIKE '%History%'
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NAME, street_address, city, state, postal_code;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    s.SESSION_LOCATION,
    t.TERM_START_DATE,
    p.PERSON_NAME AS Leader
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
    ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
    ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE ASC;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS MATERIAL_ITEM_COUNT
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM AS room_number,
  r.FLOOR AS floor,
  r.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,
  a.CITY AS city,
  a.STATE AS state,
  a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE e.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS full_room_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
  a.CITY AS city,
  a.STATE AS state,
  a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Computer Science%'
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

SELECT
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  r.ROOM AS room,
  r.FLOOR AS floor,
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,
  ba.CITY AS city,
  ba.STATE AS state,
  ba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  so.FORM_TYPE AS format,
  so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS num_enrolled_students
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
  ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
 AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300;

SELECT DISTINCT
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE,
  tm.ISBN,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS TOTAL_NEW_MATERIALS_COST_PER_SUBJECT
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.TITLE, tm.ISBN;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_long_name,
  CAST(RIGHT(b.DATE_BUILT, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS total_employees
FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.BUILDING_ROOM
WHERE b.DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL
  AND b.DATE_BUILT <> '(NULL)'
  AND RIGHT(b.DATE_BUILT, 4) REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
  AND CAST(RIGHT(b.DATE_BUILT, 4) AS UNSIGNED) < 1950
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CAST(RIGHT(b.DATE_BUILT, 4) AS UNSIGNED)
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) > 100
ORDER BY total_employees DESC, building_number;

SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_course_count
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso
  ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON cso.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.FULL_NAME) AS max_student_count
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  ON s.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.BUILDING_ROOM
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY max_student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  f.FLOOR
FROM FAC_FLOOR f
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE f.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(f.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(f2.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED))
    FROM FAC_FLOOR f2
    WHERE f2.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
  );

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fee_collected,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS distinct_iap_subjects_offered,
  MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN TIME_DAY t
  ON t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS distinct_sessions,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
  MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY END) AS sessions_with_info,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO <> 'Y' OR ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO IS NULL THEN d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY END) AS sessions_without_info
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
  ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY sp.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY sp.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  p.PERSON_EMAIL,
  p.PERSON_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS distinct_iap_subjects,
  MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
  MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
  SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_course_enrollment
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN TIME_DAY t
  ON t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  p.PERSON_EMAIL,
  p.PERSON_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  p.PERSON_EMAIL,
  p.PERSON_NAME,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT
  d.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS distinct_iap_sessions,
  SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee,
  MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  d.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS distinct_subjects_held,
  SUM(DISTINCT d.FEE) AS total_fee_across_subjects,
  MIN(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') < STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS min_session_length_minutes,
  MAX(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') < STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS max_session_length_minutes
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.SESSION_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME;

WITH session_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    d.FEE,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SESSION_LOCATION
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
),
subject_fee AS (
  SELECT
    ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    MAX(FEE) AS FEE
  FROM session_subjects
  GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE
),
session_durations AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') <= STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
        THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
               MINUTE,
               STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
               STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
             )
      ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             MINUTE,
             STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
             STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
           )
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM session_subjects
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject_fee) AS total_distinct_subjects,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(FEE), 0) FROM subject_fee) AS total_fee_across_subjects,
  (SELECT MIN(duration_minutes) FROM session_durations) AS min_session_duration_minutes,
  (SELECT MAX(duration_minutes) FROM session_durations) AS max_session_duration_minutes;

SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS distinct_courses_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN scd.COURSE END) AS distinct_degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH dept_school AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
),
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS distinct_phone_numbers
  FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  GROUP BY ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
course_level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U') AS u_cnt,
    SUM(cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G') AS g_cnt
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  GROUP BY cd.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(pc.distinct_phone_numbers, 0) AS distinct_phone_numbers,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(clc.u_cnt, 0) >= COALESCE(clc.g_cnt, 0) THEN 'U'
    ELSE 'G'
  END AS most_common_course_level
FROM dept_school ds
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN phone_counts pc
  ON pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN course_level_counts clc
  ON clc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS distinct_sis_subjects,
  MIN(CAST(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER AS UNSIGNED)) AS min_course_number,
  MAX(CAST(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_course_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS distinct_departments
FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DLC_KEY,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS total_distinct_floors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_distinct_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_distinct_facility_organizations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_distinct_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME;

WITH dlc_space AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS sqft
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
  GROUP BY
    su.DLC_KEY,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
),
dlc_space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ds.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS distinct_floors,
    SUM(ds.sqft) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_facility_organizations,
    SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, ''), 0) + 0) AS cumulative_building_height
  FROM dlc_space ds
  LEFT JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = ds.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ds.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  GROUP BY ds.DLC_KEY
),
dlc_supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS distinct_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  dsa.DLC_KEY,
  fo.DLC_NAME,
  dsa.distinct_floors,
  dsa.total_square_footage,
  dsa.distinct_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sua.distinct_supervisors, 0) AS distinct_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sua.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees,
  dsa.cumulative_building_height
FROM dlc_space_agg dsa
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fo.DLC_KEY = dsa.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN dlc_supervisor_agg sua
  ON sua.DLC_KEY = dsa.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY dsa.DLC_KEY;

SELECT
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_tip_subjects_offered,
  SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
  MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
  MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_COURSES_OFFERED,
  AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SESSION_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS TOTAL_SESSIONS_COUNT
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
  ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SESSION_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_distinct_courses
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON sc.COURSE_NUMBER = cd.COURSE
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND YEAR(t.TERM_START_DATE) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
  ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
 AND (
      (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SP' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'JA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y')
 )
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND YEAR(t.TERM_START_DATE) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.AUTHOR, ';', 1)) AS author_first,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_courses
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.AUTHOR, ';', 1)),
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    SUM(COALESCE(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_new_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS total_used_shelf_price,
    MIN(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_shelf_price,
    MAX(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS max_used_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS distinct_materials
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools,
  MAX(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(tm.YEAR), '') AS UNSIGNED)) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS distinct_tip_subjects_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS distinct_materials,
  MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
  MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools_offering,
  COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_record_count
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY
  at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT DISTINCT
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
    ba.CITY,
    ba.STATE,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS assignable_square_footage,
    SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_square_footage,
    AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_room_square_footage
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
    ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
   AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
GROUP BY
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
    ba.CITY,
    ba.STATE,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
    total_room_square_footage DESC,
    avg_room_square_footage DESC;

SELECT
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.PREREQUISITES,
  c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS INSTRUCTOR,
  t.total_subjects_in_term,
  i.instructor_subject_count_all_records
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_in_term
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
) t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS instructor_subject_count_all_records
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''
  GROUP BY FALL_INSTRUCTORS
) i
  ON i.FALL_INSTRUCTORS = c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS
WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.SUBJECT_ID;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100
  END AS pct_of_assignable_floor_area,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100
  END AS pct_of_assignable_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department,
  CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS room_area,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fa.total_floor_area, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / fa.total_floor_area) * 100
  END AS pct_of_floor_area,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ba.total_building_area, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / ba.total_building_area) * 100
  END AS pct_of_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) AS total_floor_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY
) fa
  ON fa.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) AS total_building_area
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ed.FULL_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS distinct_courses_taught
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
  ON so.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
GROUP BY
  ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ed.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY
  ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ed.FULL_NAME;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  o.ORGANIZATION AS organization,
  MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS highest_floor_number,
  MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS lowest_floor_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS distinct_room_count
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  o.ORGANIZATION;

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS full_name,
  msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS email_address,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd2.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2
    WHERE msd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT
  ) AS distinct_students_in_same_department,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT msd3.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd3
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd3
      ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd3.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE
  ) AS distinct_students_in_same_school
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
ORDER BY msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  e.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c2.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_SUBJECTS_RESPONSIBLE_FOR_ACROSS_FALL_TERMS
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2
  ON c2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
 AND c2.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
GROUP BY
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
HAVING c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
ORDER BY
  c.TERM_CODE,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_gross_square_footage,
  SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_assignable_square_footage,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(fb.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS year_built
FROM BUILDINGS b
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  fb.DATE_BUILT;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS course_description,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_name,
  f.LEVEL_ID AS floor_level,
  a.STREET_NUMBER,
  a.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
  a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.STREET_NAME,
  a.STREET_SUFFIX,
  a.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  a.CITY,
  a.STATE,
  a.POSTAL_CODE,
  dept.dept_distinct_course_count AS distinct_courses_in_same_department
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_distinct_course_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) dept
  ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU%';

SELECT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS attribute_description,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_distinct_subjects
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h
  ON h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE h.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS gross_square_footage,
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS assignable_square_footage,
    flr.min_level_id AS smallest_floor_level,
    flr.max_level_id AS highest_floor_level,
    rm.total_room_area AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        MIN(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS min_level_id,
        MAX(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_level_id
    FROM FAC_FLOOR
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) flr
    ON flr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        r.BUILDING_KEY,
        SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
    FROM FAC_ROOMS r
    GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
) rm
    ON rm.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  c.CATEGORY_CODE AS cip_category_code,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE AS category_title,
  c.VERSION AS version,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undergraduate_level_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graduate_level_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN CIP c
  ON scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = c.PROGRAM_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  c.CATEGORY_CODE,
  c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  c.VERSION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.COURSE_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS distinct_materials_on_reserve,
  MIN(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS earliest_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS latest_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lci.COURSE_NAME
ORDER BY lci.COURSE_NAME;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS total_distinct_library_reserve_materials,
  MIN(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS earliest_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS latest_publication_year,
  SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS library_material_status,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS distinct_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS distinct_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS distinct_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

WITH floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations_on_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS distinct_space_units_on_floor
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
  GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_KEY, sd.FLOOR_KEY
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit,
  sf.FLOOR AS floor,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  fba.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS building_street_address,
  susage.SPACE_USAGE AS space_usage,
  fc.distinct_organizations_on_floor,
  fc.distinct_space_units_on_floor
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
 AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
  ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_USAGE susage
  ON susage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
JOIN floor_counts fc
  ON fc.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
 AND fc.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
ORDER BY
  sf.FLOOR,
  su.SPACE_UNIT,
  susage.SPACE_USAGE;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER,
  COUNT(*) AS total_people
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY total_people DESC, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, mlo.OWNER;

WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    mlo.OWNER AS owner,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN AS is_hidden,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT MIN(member_count) AS min_cnt, MAX(member_count) AS max_cnt
  FROM member_counts
)
SELECT
  mc.list_name,
  mc.owner,
  mc.is_public,
  mc.is_hidden,
  mc.member_count
FROM member_counts mc
JOIN extremes e
  ON mc.member_count IN (e.min_cnt, e.max_cnt)
ORDER BY
  mc.member_count,
  mc.list_name,
  mc.owner;

SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_on_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS distinct_responsible_faculty_for_summer_courses_after_2001
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
    ON ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs
    ON ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'C%'
  AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
  AND at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

  COUNT(DISTINCT sp.MIT_ID) AS distinct_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT msd.DEPARTMENT) AS distinct_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS distinct_schools
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld

JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER

  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT

WITH lists_10 AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = 10
),
faculty_courses_2023fa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS distinct_responsible_faculty_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS distinct_courses_count
FROM lists_10 AS l10
JOIN MOIRA_LIST AS ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
  ON ed.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN faculty_courses_2023fa AS fc
  ON fc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    MIN(CASE
            WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        END) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(CASE
            WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        END) AS latest_publication_year,
    SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON LOWER(sp.KRB_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
    OR LOWER(sp.FULL_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME)
    OR sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
  AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION AS list_description,
  mlo.OWNER AS list_owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS total_distinct_people,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN sp.PAYROLL_RANK LIKE '%Tenured%' THEN mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS distinct_tenured_faculty
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'R%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
    JOIN SE_PERSON sp2
      ON sp2.MIT_ID = mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
    WHERE mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      AND sp2.FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
  )
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  mlo.OWNER
ORDER BY
  total_distinct_people DESC;

  SUM(CASE WHEN sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_student_count,

    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),

  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT

WITH floor_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    ff.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    (MAX(CAST(ff.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) - MIN(CAST(ff.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) + 1) AS floor_count
  FROM FAC_FLOOR ff
  WHERE ff.LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY ff.BUILDING_KEY
),
max_buildings AS (
  SELECT fr.building_key
  FROM floor_ranges fr
  JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count
    FROM floor_ranges
  ) m ON m.max_floor_count = fr.floor_count
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM max_buildings mb
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = mb.building_key
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = e.KRB_NAME
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%'
  AND e.KRB_NAME LIKE 'C%';

SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ed.LAST_NAME) AS distinct_responsible_faculty_last_names
FROM MOIRA_LIST AS ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c
    ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  ml_size.total_members AS mailing_list_total_size

JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME

  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT

WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  AND msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%';

WITH list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sp.MIT_ID) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'B%'
    AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND sp.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering and Computer Science'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS distinct_mailing_list_count
  FROM list_member_counts
),
top_list AS (
  SELECT MOIRA_LIST_NAME, distinct_member_count
  FROM list_member_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_member_count DESC, MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  s.distinct_mailing_list_count,
  t.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS highest_member_list_name,
  t.distinct_member_count AS highest_member_count
FROM summary s
CROSS JOIN top_list t;

WITH list_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         sp.MIT_ID,
         msd.DEPARTMENT
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS total_students
  FROM list_students
)
SELECT
  sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ls.MIT_ID) AS distinct_students,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ls.MIT_ID) / t.total_students, 2) AS pct_of_total_distinct_students
FROM list_students ls
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ls.DEPARTMENT
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.total_students
ORDER BY distinct_students DESC, department_name;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS subscriber_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '24%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY subscriber_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_ACTIVE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_staff_subscribers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faculty_subscribers
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml

  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE IN ('Support Staff', 'Faculty')

  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_ACTIVE;

WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_distinct_students
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = UPPER(sp.KRB_NAME)
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON UPPER(sp.FULL_NAME) = UPPER(msd.FULL_NAME)
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'
  GROUP BY
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    dc.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dc.total_distinct_students DESC) AS rnk
  FROM dept_counts dc
)
SELECT
  department_name,
  department_phone_number,
  total_distinct_students
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS group_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  CASE
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS distinct_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
  AND UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
  ml.IS_PUBLIC WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  group_name,
  CASE
    WHEN member_visibility = 'Public Members' THEN 1
    WHEN member_visibility = 'Hidden Members' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END;

WITH sos_bio AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%Biology%'
),
cluster_avg AS (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster_type
  FROM sos_bio
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, CLUSTER_TYPE
),
tip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_price,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_price,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS total_tip_record_count
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
lib_agg AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_library_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS unique_library_isbns
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  b.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  SUM(COALESCE(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  ca.avg_enrollment_within_cluster_type,
  SUM(COALESCE(ta.unique_course_materials, 0)) AS unique_course_materials,
  AVG(ta.avg_new_price) AS avg_new_price,
  AVG(ta.avg_used_price) AS avg_used_price,
  SUM(COALESCE(ta.total_tip_record_count, 0)) AS total_tip_record_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(la.unique_library_titles, 0)) AS unique_library_titles,
  SUM(COALESCE(la.unique_library_isbns, 0)) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM sos_bio b
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = b.COURSE_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN cluster_avg ca
  ON ca.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
 AND ca.CLUSTER_TYPE = b.CLUSTER_TYPE
LEFT JOIN tip_agg ta
  ON ta.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = b.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN lib_agg la
  ON la.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER = b.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
  ca.avg_enrollment_within_cluster_type
ORDER BY
  department,
  course_title,
  cluster_type;

WITH RECURSIVE
subjects_base AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        c.SUBJECT_ID,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.TERM_CODE,
        at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
        c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
        c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
        c.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
        ON at.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
        ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
        ON scd.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
       AND c.TERM_CODE BETWEEN scd.FROM_TERM AND scd.THRU_TERM
    WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND (c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
),
subject_terms AS (
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        SCHOOL_NAME,
        SUBJECT_ID,
        SUBJECT_TITLE,
        COURSE_LEVEL,
        TOTAL_UNITS,
        TERM_CODE,
        TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        'Fall' AS offered_term,
        FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructors
    FROM subjects_base
    WHERE IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        SCHOOL_NAME,
        SUBJECT_ID,
        SUBJECT_TITLE,
        COURSE_LEVEL,
        TOTAL_UNITS,
        TERM_CODE,
        TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        'Spring' AS offered_term,
        SPRING_INSTRUCTORS AS instructors
    FROM subjects_base
    WHERE IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
),
split_instructors AS (
    SELECT
        st.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        st.SCHOOL_NAME,
        st.SUBJECT_ID,
        st.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        st.COURSE_LEVEL,
        st.TOTAL_UNITS,
        st.offered_term,
        st.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        TRIM(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(CONCAT(st.instructors, ','), ',', 1),
                ',', -1
            )
        ) AS instructor,
        SUBSTRING(CONCAT(st.instructors, ','), LOCATE(',', CONCAT(st.instructors, ',')) + 1) AS rest
    FROM subject_terms st

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        si.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        si.SCHOOL_NAME,
        si.SUBJECT_ID,
        si.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        si.COURSE_LEVEL,
        si.TOTAL_UNITS,
        si.offered_term,
        si.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(si.rest, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        SUBSTRING(si.rest, LOCATE(',', si.rest) + 1) AS rest
    FROM split_instructors si
    WHERE si.rest IS NOT NULL
      AND si.rest <> ''
      AND LOCATE(',', si.rest) > 0
)
SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COURSE_LEVEL,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    offered_term AS OFFERED_TERM,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instructor, '')) AS DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS
FROM split_instructors
GROUP BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COURSE_LEVEL,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    offered_term,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    OFFERED_TERM;

SELECT
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS hass_attribute_name,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS hass_attribute_description,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects,
  AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_units,
  SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_student_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS distinct_degree_granting_departments
FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ccc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd_pol
  ON sd_pol.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2
  ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE sd_pol.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
  AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
GROUP BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
ORDER BY
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC;

SELECT
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS is_degree_granting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered,
  SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment,
  AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrollment
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER
WHERE sos.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(sos.CLUSTER_TYPE) <> ''
  AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(sd.SCHOOL_NAME) <> ''
  AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
GROUP BY
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
ORDER BY
  sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    CASE
      WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate'
      WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS course_level_group,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.MEET_PLACE = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.COURSE = so.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
),
instructors_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS distinct_instructors_all_levels
  FROM base
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> ''
  GROUP BY FAC_BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.building_name,
  b.course_level_group AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_course_count,
  ibb.distinct_instructors_all_levels AS distinct_instructors_all_course_levels
FROM base b
JOIN instructors_by_building ibb
  ON ibb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE b.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND b.SUBJECT_ID <> ''
GROUP BY
  b.building_name,
  b.course_level_group,
  ibb.distinct_instructors_all_levels
ORDER BY
  distinct_course_count DESC,
  building_name ASC;

SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE,

  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_meeting,

JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr

  ON fmu.MAJOR_USE_KEY = fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY

  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

  total_units_scheduled DESC,
  room_number;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS catalog_key,
    lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS subject_offered_key,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS num_enrolled_students
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
    ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
    AND CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000
),
dept_level AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS distinct_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    1 AS sort_group
  FROM base
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
status_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS distinct_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    2 AS sort_group
  FROM base
  GROUP BY material_status
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL MATERIAL STATUSES' AS material_status,
    'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS distinct_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    3 AS sort_group
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  distinct_catalog_items,
  total_enrolled_students
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM dept_level
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM status_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_group,
  material_status,
  department_name;

WITH course_level AS (
  SELECT
    lci.DEPARTMENT AS department,
    lci.COURSE_NAME AS course_name,
    SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS course_total_enrollment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS course_distinct_catalog_items
  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
  GROUP BY
    lci.DEPARTMENT,
    lci.COURSE_NAME
),
dept_level AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_courses,
    SUM(course_distinct_catalog_items) AS total_distinct_catalog_items,
    AVG(course_total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
  FROM course_level
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT
  department,
  distinct_courses,
  total_distinct_catalog_items,
  avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS department,
    SUM(distinct_courses) AS distinct_courses,
    SUM(total_distinct_catalog_items) AS total_distinct_catalog_items,
    AVG(avg_enrollment_per_course) AS avg_enrollment_per_course,
    0 AS sort_key
  FROM dept_level

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    department,
    distinct_courses,
    total_distinct_catalog_items,
    avg_enrollment_per_course,
    1 AS sort_key
  FROM dept_level
) x
ORDER BY
  sort_key,
  department;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS material_key,
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS course_key,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_price,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE AS used_price,
    COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0) AS record_count,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS material_status_key
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE so.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT material_key) AS unique_course_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course_key) AS number_of_courses,
  AVG(new_price) AS avg_new_price,
  AVG(used_price) AS avg_used_price,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT material_status_key) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM base
GROUP BY school_name, department_name

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS school_name,
  NULL AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT material_key) AS unique_course_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT course_key) AS number_of_courses,
  AVG(new_price) AS avg_new_price,
  AVG(used_price) AS avg_used_price,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT material_status_key) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM base
ORDER BY
  school_name,
  department_name;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS), ''), 'No material status') AS material_status,
    tm.TITLE AS material_title,
    td.RECORD_COUNT AS record_count,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS num_enrolled_students
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_title) AS distinct_materials,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > 0 THEN record_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(num_enrolled_students, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_student_enrollment
  FROM base
  GROUP BY material_status
),
grand AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_title) AS distinct_materials,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > 0 THEN record_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(num_enrolled_students, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_student_enrollment
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  distinct_materials,
  total_records,
  total_student_enrollment
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS is_grand_total, a.* FROM agg a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 AS is_grand_total, g.* FROM grand g
) x
ORDER BY
  is_grand_total ASC,
  total_records DESC,
  material_status ASC;

WITH
room_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    f.FLOOR,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(AREA) AS building_total_area
  FROM room_base
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(AREA) AS overall_total_area
  FROM room_base
),
detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    rb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    rb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    rb.FLOOR,
    rb.BUILDING_ROOM,
    rb.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(rb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(rb.AREA) AS total_area,
    (SUM(rb.AREA) / bt.building_total_area) * 100 AS pct_of_total_area,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM room_base rb
  JOIN building_totals bt
    ON bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    rb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    rb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    rb.FLOOR,
    rb.BUILDING_ROOM,
    rb.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    bt.building_total_area
),
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    rb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    rb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(rb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(rb.AREA) AS total_area,
    (SUM(rb.AREA) / ot.overall_total_area) * 100 AS pct_of_total_area,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM room_base rb
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
  GROUP BY
    rb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    rb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    ot.overall_total_area
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(rb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(rb.AREA) AS total_area,
    100.0 AS pct_of_total_area,
    3 AS sort_level
  FROM room_base rb
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  FLOOR,
  BUILDING_ROOM,
  ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  total_rooms,
  total_area,
  pct_of_total_area
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN x.sort_level = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  x.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  x.sort_level,
  CAST(x.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED),
  x.BUILDING_ROOM;

SELECT
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS financial_aid_year,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS distinct_fiscal_periods,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS distinct_quarters,
  MIN(td.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_term_date,
  MAX(td.END_DATE) AS latest_end_term_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS distinct_department_level_term_parameters
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
LEFT JOIN TIME_DAY td
  ON td.CALENDAR_DATE = at.TERM_START_DATE
LEFT JOIN TIME_MONTH tm
  ON tm.FISCAL_PERIOD = td.FISCAL_PERIOD
LEFT JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq
  ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR DESC,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC;

WITH
addr AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CITY)  AS CITY,
    MAX(STATE) AS STATE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR) AS distinct_floors
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
room_org_counts AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(fc.distinct_floors, 0) AS distinct_floors,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
    COALESCE(rc.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(rc.distinct_organizations, 0) AS distinct_organizations,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.CAMPUS_SECTOR
      ORDER BY COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) DESC, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG
    ) - 1 AS sector_rank
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN addr a
    ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floor_counts fc
    ON fc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN room_org_counts rc
    ON rc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SUM(distinct_floors) AS distinct_floors,
    CAST(SUM(total_assignable_area_no_decimals) AS UNSIGNED) AS total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS distinct_organizations,
    NULL AS sector_rank
  FROM building_rows
)
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  building_name,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  distinct_floors,
  total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
  total_rooms,
  distinct_organizations,
  sector_rank
FROM building_rows

UNION ALL

SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  building_name,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  distinct_floors,
  total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
  total_rooms,
  distinct_organizations,
  sector_rank
FROM grand_total

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  sector_rank,
  building_name;

WITH
tip_materials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
         tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
         tm.TITLE,
         tm.ISBN
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
lib_by_isbn AS (
  SELECT
      lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS isbn,
      MIN(lrmd.TERM_CODE) AS library_term_code,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS distinct_instructors
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_ISBN
),
dept_lib_distinct_materials AS (
  SELECT
      lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS dept_distinct_lib_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
overall_lib_distinct_materials AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS overall_distinct_lib_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> ''
)
SELECT
    tm.dept_name AS department_name,
    tm.TITLE AS tip_material_title,
    tm.ISBN AS tip_material_isbn,
    lbi.library_term_code,
    CASE WHEN lbi.isbn IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS is_available_in_library_reserves,
    COALESCE(lbi.distinct_instructors, 0) AS distinct_instructors_for_isbn_in_library_reserves,
    COALESCE(dldm.dept_distinct_lib_materials, 0) AS dept_total_distinct_materials_in_library_reserves,
    oldm.overall_distinct_lib_materials AS overall_total_distinct_materials_in_library_reserves
FROM tip_materials tm
LEFT JOIN lib_by_isbn lbi
  ON lbi.isbn = tm.ISBN
LEFT JOIN dept_lib_distinct_materials dldm
  ON dldm.dept_name = tm.dept_name
CROSS JOIN overall_lib_distinct_materials oldm
ORDER BY
    tm.dept_name,
    tm.TITLE;

SELECT
  dept_name,
  material_status,
  tip_materials,
  library_materials,
  (tip_materials + library_materials) AS total_materials
FROM (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    material_status,
    SUM(tip_cnt) AS tip_materials,
    SUM(lib_cnt) AS library_materials
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
      tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
      COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS tip_cnt,
      0 AS lib_cnt
    FROM TIP_DETAIL td
    JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
      ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
      ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    GROUP BY
      tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
      lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
      0 AS tip_cnt,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS lib_cnt
    FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd
    JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
      ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
      ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    GROUP BY
      lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
  ) x
  GROUP BY
    dept_name,
    material_status WITH ROLLUP
) r
ORDER BY
  (dept_name IS NULL) ASC,
  dept_name ASC,
  (material_status IS NULL) ASC,
  material_status ASC;

SELECT

SELECT

WITH base AS (

    CAST(SUBSTRING(DATE_BUILT, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS construction_start_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CAST(SUBSTRING(DATE_OCCUPIED, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS initial_occupancy_year
  FROM FAC_BUILDING
  WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR TRIM(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) = '')
    AND DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DATE_BUILT) <> ''
    AND DATE_OCCUPIED IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DATE_OCCUPIED) <> ''
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY construction_start_year ORDER BY building_number) = 1
        THEN CAST(construction_start_year AS CHAR)
      ELSE ''
    END AS construction_start_year,
    building_number,
    initial_occupancy_year,
    0 AS sort_group,
    construction_start_year AS sort_year
  FROM base
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    '' AS construction_start_year,
    CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
    NULL AS initial_occupancy_year,
    1 AS sort_group,
    999999 AS sort_year
  FROM base
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM summary
) x
ORDER BY sort_group, sort_year, building_number;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    BUILDING_USE,
    COALESCE(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_group_id,
    SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
  WHERE SITE = 'MIT'
  GROUP BY
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    BUILDING_USE,
    COALESCE(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    bh.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    bh.BUILDING_USE,
    COALESCE(bh.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_group_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rm.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS distinct_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS rm
    ON rm.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION org
    ON org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = rm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE bh.SITE = 'MIT'
  GROUP BY
    bh.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    bh.BUILDING_USE,
    COALESCE(bh.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
)
SELECT
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  b.BUILDING_USE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.building_group_id) AS distinct_buildings,
  SUM(b.gross_sqft) AS total_gross_sqft,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.building_group_id) AS buildings_with_rooms_or_orgs,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.distinct_rooms, 0)) AS distinct_rooms_associated,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.distinct_organizations, 0)) AS distinct_organizations_associated
FROM b
LEFT JOIN r
  ON r.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
 AND r.BUILDING_USE = b.BUILDING_USE
 AND r.building_group_id = b.building_group_id
GROUP BY
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  b.BUILDING_USE
ORDER BY
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE DESC,
  b.BUILDING_USE;

WITH building_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_group_id,
    CASE
      WHEN b.BUILDING_USE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE b.BUILDING_USE
    END AS building_use_norm,
    b.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL
),
building_group_gross AS (
  SELECT
    building_use_norm,
    building_group_id,
    MAX(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft
  FROM building_base
  GROUP BY building_use_norm, building_group_id
),
orgs_by_use AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bb.building_use_norm,
    r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  FROM building_base bb
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
per_use AS (
  SELECT
    g.building_use_norm AS building_use,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_buildings,
    SUM(g.gross_sqft) AS total_gross_sqft,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orgs_by_use o WHERE o.building_use_norm = g.building_use_norm) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM building_group_gross g
  GROUP BY g.building_use_norm
),
all_buildings_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_group_id,
    b.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
),
all_buildings_group_gross AS (
  SELECT
    building_group_id,
    MAX(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft
  FROM all_buildings_base
  GROUP BY building_group_id
),
all_orgs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  WHERE r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.building_use,
  p.distinct_buildings,
  p.total_gross_sqft,
  p.distinct_organizations
FROM per_use p

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_use,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_buildings_group_gross) AS distinct_buildings,
  (SELECT SUM(gross_sqft) FROM all_buildings_group_gross) AS total_gross_sqft,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_orgs) AS distinct_organizations

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN building_use = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_use;

SELECT

  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  CONCAT(REPEAT('  ', GREATEST(CAST(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) - 1, 0)), o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS indented_organization_name,
  CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'assignable' ELSE 'non-assignable' END AS assignable_status,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.AREA), 0) AS total_room_area,
  COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
  COALESCE(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SELECT

    WHEN '1' THEN 'Assignable'
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Non-assignable'
    ELSE mu.ASSIGNABLE
  END AS room_category,
  COALESCE(mu.DESCRIPTION, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS major_use_description,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
  SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
  AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
WHERE NOT (
  mu.MAJOR_USE LIKE 'ZUSE%' OR mu.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'ZUSE%'
)
GROUP BY

  COALESCE(mu.DESCRIPTION, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  CASE mu.ASSIGNABLE
    WHEN '1' THEN 'Assignable'
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Non-assignable'
    ELSE mu.ASSIGNABLE
  END AS room_category,
  'Subtotal' AS major_use_description,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
  SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
  AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area

JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
WHERE NOT (
  mu.MAJOR_USE LIKE 'ZUSE%' OR mu.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'ZUSE%'
)
GROUP BY
  mu.ASSIGNABLE
ORDER BY

  CASE WHEN major_use_description = 'Subtotal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,

  GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, FLOOR, department_name

floor_subtotal AS (

overall_total AS (

  FROM base

SELECT
