  total_room_area,
  avg_room_area
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall_total

ORDER BY

  sort_group,
  department_name;

SELECT

WITH

agg AS (

    SUM(COALESCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_max_enrollment,
    MIN(TERM_CODE) AS earliest_term_code,
    MAX(TERM_CODE) AS latest_term_code
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
sponsor_rank AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SPONSOR_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SPONSOR_NAME
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, SPONSOR_NAME
),
start_time_rank AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SESSION_START_TIME,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SESSION_START_TIME
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, SESSION_START_TIME
)
SELECT
  a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  a.distinct_session_count,
  a.total_max_enrollment,
  CONCAT(a.earliest_term_code, ' to ', a.latest_term_code) AS active_period,
  sr.SPONSOR_NAME AS most_common_sponsor_name,
  tr.SESSION_START_TIME AS most_common_session_start_time
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN sponsor_rank sr
  ON sr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
 AND sr.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN start_time_rank tr
  ON tr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
 AND tr.rn = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS distinct_session_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_max_enrollment,
  NULL AS active_period,
  NULL AS most_common_sponsor_name,
  NULL AS most_common_session_start_time
FROM base

ORDER BY category_name;

WITH latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = h.FISCAL_PERIOD
),
bldg_base AS (
  SELECT
    lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    CASE
      WHEN lb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE lb.BUILDING_TYPE
    END AS building_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS parent_or_key,
    lb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS ext_gross_area
  FROM latest_bldg lb
),
street_addr AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
bldg_street AS (
  SELECT
    bb.building_key,
    bb.building_type,
    bb.parent_or_key,
    bb.ext_gross_area,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    sa.CITY,
    sa.STATE,
    sa.POSTAL_CODE
  FROM bldg_base bb
  JOIN street_addr sa
    ON sa.building_key = bb.building_key
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bb.building_key
),
emp_in_bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    ed.MIT_ID
  FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
),
bldg_emp AS (
  SELECT
    bs.building_key,
    bs.building_type,
    bs.parent_or_key,
    bs.ext_gross_area,
    bs.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    bs.CITY,
    bs.STATE,
    bs.POSTAL_CODE,
    eib.MIT_ID
  FROM bldg_street bs
  LEFT JOIN emp_in_bldg eib
    ON eib.building_key = bs.building_key
),
type_emp AS (
  SELECT
    building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS distinct_employees
  FROM bldg_emp
  GROUP BY building_type
),
type_gross AS (
  SELECT
    building_type,
    SUM(ext_gross_area) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT building_type, building_key, ext_gross_area
    FROM bldg_street
  ) x
  GROUP BY building_type
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT parent_or_key) AS distinct_buildings_not_subdivisions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS distinct_street_addresses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS distinct_cities,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS distinct_states,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS distinct_postal_codes
  FROM bldg_street
  GROUP BY building_type
),
type_result AS (
  SELECT
    tc.building_type,
    tc.distinct_buildings_not_subdivisions,
    te.distinct_employees,
    tc.distinct_street_addresses,
    tc.distinct_cities,
    tc.distinct_states,
    tc.distinct_postal_codes,
    CASE
      WHEN te.distinct_employees = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE tg.total_gross_sqft / te.distinct_employees
    END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM type_counts tc
  LEFT JOIN type_emp te ON te.building_type = tc.building_type
  LEFT JOIN type_gross tg ON tg.building_type = tc.building_type
),
total_emp AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS distinct_employees
  FROM bldg_emp
),
total_gross AS (
  SELECT SUM(ext_gross_area) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT building_key, ext_gross_area
    FROM bldg_street
  ) x
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT parent_or_key) AS distinct_buildings_not_subdivisions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS distinct_street_addresses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS distinct_cities,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS distinct_states,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS distinct_postal_codes
  FROM bldg_street
)
SELECT
  r.building_type,
  r.distinct_buildings_not_subdivisions,
  r.distinct_employees,
  r.distinct_street_addresses,
  r.distinct_cities,
  r.distinct_states,
  r.distinct_postal_codes,
  r.avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM type_result r

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  tc.distinct_buildings_not_subdivisions,
  te.distinct_employees,
  tc.distinct_street_addresses,
  tc.distinct_cities,
  tc.distinct_states,
  tc.distinct_postal_codes,
  CASE
    WHEN te.distinct_employees = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE tg.total_gross_sqft / te.distinct_employees
  END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM total_counts tc
CROSS JOIN total_emp te
CROSS JOIN total_gross tg

ORDER BY building_type ASC;

SELECT
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
  su_usage.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
  fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS distinct_space_count,
  SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_area,
  AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_area
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
  ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
 AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
JOIN SPACE_USAGE su_usage
  ON su_usage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
  AND su_usage.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
GROUP BY
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  su_usage.SPACE_USAGE,
  fo.DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  z.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  su_usage.SPACE_USAGE,
  fo.DLC_NAME;

SELECT
  SUBSTRING(fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT, 5, 2) AS break_group,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      THEN CONCAT(' ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    ELSE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  END AS organization_name,
  CASE
    WHEN hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> '' THEN 'Emeritus'
    ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
  END AS emeritus_status,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hfr.MIT_ID) AS distinct_employers_in_hr_org_unit,
  mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE AS hierarchy_type,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT AS break_group_code
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
  ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou
  ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hfr
  ON hfr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
WHERE CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 3 AND 6
  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('139', '250')
GROUP BY
  SUBSTRING(fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT, 5, 2),
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      THEN CONCAT(' ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    ELSE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> '' THEN 'Emeritus'
    ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
  END,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT
ORDER BY
  mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  emeritus_status;

WITH base AS (

      c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
      b.BUILDING_NAME,
      t.TERM_CODE,
      t.TERM_START_DATE,
      t.TERM_END_DATE,
      DATEDIFF(t.TERM_END_DATE, t.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_duration_days
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t

  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r

  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b

  WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

    BUILDING_NAME,
    term_duration_days,
    AVG(term_duration_days) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ORDER BY TERM_START_DATE
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS term_duration_5_term_moving_avg_days

ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, SUBJECT_TITLE, BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,

  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,

  LAG(c.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS previous_course_name,
  LEAD(c.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS next_course_name

SELECT

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Non-Current' END AS current_label,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS is_current_term,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  current_label,
  cluster_type,
  MAX(term_duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
  MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
  AVG(term_duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
  AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
FROM base
GROUP BY is_current_term, current_label, cluster_type

UNION ALL

SELECT
  current_label,
  'Subtotal' AS cluster_type,
  MAX(term_duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
  MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
  AVG(term_duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
  AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
FROM base
GROUP BY is_current_term, current_label

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Overall Total' AS current_label,
  'Total' AS cluster_type,
  MAX(term_duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
  MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
  AVG(term_duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
  AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
FROM base
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN current_label = 'Current' THEN 0
    WHEN current_label = 'Non-Current' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  current_label,
  CASE
    WHEN cluster_type NOT IN ('Subtotal', 'Total') THEN 0
    WHEN cluster_type = 'Subtotal' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  cluster_type;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current'
    WHEN a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' THEN 'Non-current'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS term_current_category,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
    ELSE su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  END AS department,
  MAX(DATEDIFF(a.TERM_END_DATE, a.TERM_START_DATE)) AS max_term_duration_days,
  MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
  AVG(DATEDIFF(a.TERM_END_DATE, a.TERM_START_DATE)) AS avg_term_duration_days,
  AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a
JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  ON ss.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED su
  ON su.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
GROUP BY a.IS_CURRENT_TERM, su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (GROUPING(a.IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 0 AND GROUPING(su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1)
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(a.IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 1 THEN 2
    WHEN a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 0
    WHEN a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' THEN 1
    ELSE 1
  END,
  term_current_category,
  CASE WHEN department = 'Subtotal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  department;

SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
       WHEN GROUPING(tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) = 1 THEN CONCAT(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ' SUBTOTAL')
       ELSE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  END AS offer_dept_name,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 OR GROUPING(tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
  END AS master_course_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS total_new_shelf_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS distinct_tip_materials
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  (tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL) ASC,
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC,
  (tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL) ASC,
  tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER ASC;

WITH course_base AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
course_level AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    MAX(equiv_cnt) AS equiv_cnt
  FROM course_base
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
),
dept_term AS (
  SELECT
    cl.TERM_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
  GROUP BY cl.TERM_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
term_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    cl.TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
  GROUP BY cl.TERM_CODE
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'Overall Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
)
SELECT
  x.TERM_CODE,
  x.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  x.distinct_courses_offered,
  x.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM (
  SELECT
    dt.TERM_CODE,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dt.distinct_courses_offered,
    dt.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    0 AS sort_group,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM dept_term dt

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ts.TERM_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ts.distinct_courses_offered,
    ts.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    1 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZZZZZZ' AS sort_dept
  FROM term_subtotal ts

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ot.TERM_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ot.distinct_courses_offered,
    ot.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    2 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZZZZZZ' AS sort_dept
  FROM overall_total ot
) x
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = x.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  (x.TERM_CODE IS NULL) ASC,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Not Current' END AS current_term_status,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
    ) AS session_minutes
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  WHERE iss.SESSION_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND iss.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND iss.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_term_status,
    session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(session_minutes) AS total_session_minutes,
    AVG(session_minutes) AS avg_session_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_term_status, session_name
),
subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    current_term_status,
    'ALL' AS session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(session_minutes) AS total_session_minutes,
    AVG(session_minutes) AS avg_session_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_term_status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL' AS current_term_status,
    'ALL' AS session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(session_minutes) AS total_session_minutes,
    AVG(session_minutes) AS avg_session_minutes
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  current_term_status,
  session_name,
  iap_sessions,
  total_session_minutes,
  avg_session_minutes
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE current_term_status WHEN 'Current' THEN 1 WHEN 'Not Current' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  CASE WHEN session_name = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  session_name;

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS TERM_CODE,
  NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN TERM_CODE = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'E%'
  AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) > 0.75;

WITH student_lists AS (
  SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME,
    s.DEPARTMENT,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  JOIN SE_PERSON p
    ON p.FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = p.MIT_ID
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
    AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
),
list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  sl.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
  AVG(ls.member_count) AS avg_mailing_list_size
FROM student_lists sl
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sl.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN list_sizes ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
GROUP BY
  sl.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  sl.FULL_NAME;

WITH list_totals AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
student_dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_student_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
  GROUP BY
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
ranked_depts AS (
  SELECT
    sdc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sdc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY sdc.dept_student_subscribers DESC, sdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ) AS rn
  FROM student_dept_counts sdc
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  ml.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  lt.total_subscribers,
  rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_student_department,
  rd.dept_student_subscribers AS top_department_student_subscriber_count
FROM list_totals lt
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lt.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN ranked_depts rd
  ON rd.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lt.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND rd.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  lt.total_subscribers DESC,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  COALESCE(f.total_assignable_area, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(f.total_non_assignable_area, 0) AS total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(r.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_non_assignable_area
  FROM FAC_FLOOR
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) f
  ON f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  MAX(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS max_room_area,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION org
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
GROUP BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME
ORDER BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.DATE_BUILT AS construction_date,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  COALESCE(a.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_gross_area,
  COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS address_count
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.DATE_BUILT,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  a.address_count,
  r.room_count
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS distinct_courses_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS distinct_reserved_material_titles,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS distinct_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  distinct_courses_offered DESC,
  department_name ASC;

SELECT
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  COUNT(lrrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lrrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY
  total_reserved_materials DESC;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.COURSE_NAME) AS distinct_courses_taught,
  COUNT(*) AS total_material_assignments,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS avg_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  distinct_courses_taught DESC,
  instructor_name;

SELECT
  rc.CATALOG_YEAR AS publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS distinct_reserved_materials,
  AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(rc.CATALOG_TITLE)) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_statuses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ci.COURSE_NAME) AS distinct_courses
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL md
  ON md.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms
  ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = md.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR ci
  ON ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = md.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR
ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(rc.CATALOG_YEAR, '') AS UNSIGNED) DESC, rc.CATALOG_YEAR DESC;

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS activity_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee_per_activity
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  activity_count DESC;

SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_iap_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_subjects
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION sess
  ON sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY
  s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  total_iap_sessions DESC,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  p.PERSON_ROLE AS role,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS distinct_people,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
  ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY
  p.PERSON_ROLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  distinct_people DESC;

WITH building_floor_span AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    (MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) - MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED))) AS floor_span
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE f.LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_span AS (
  SELECT MAX(floor_span) AS max_floor_span
  FROM building_floor_span
)
SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME
FROM building_floor_span bfs
JOIN max_span ms
  ON bfs.floor_span = ms.max_floor_span;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS distinct_instructors,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(e.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_instructor_name_length
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
  AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND e.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY,
  o.OWNER AS owner_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS distinct_mailing_lists,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS distinct_members
FROM MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = 'LIST69.377-keeper-xenon'
GROUP BY
  o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY,
  o.OWNER;

SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_distinct_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS degree_granting_distinct_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS distinct_student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS max_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER;
